question: What does the direct post-threshold normalized-index-27 branch write after Statue of Liberty completion?

scope.boundary: This packet follows only the index-27 branch from the accepted city-update caller through its bounded city-table loop. Later city refresh, save behavior, other callers, and runtime execution remain outside this packet.

dependencies.use: Binds item 227 to Statue of Liberty and its stored description.
Provides the direct mode-one city call and normalized-index guard.
Corroborates city population byte +0x03 and signed clamping interpretation.

staticBranch.gate: At 0x82D16EA8 the helper compares normalized index with 27; other indices branch to the index-one test at 0x82D16FE8. The direct city-update caller supplies mode one and a city index whose signed owner byte +0x00 was loaded into r21 at helper entry.
staticBranch.scan: Starting at city-table base +0x03, the branch processes four 0xBC-byte city records per loop and advances by 0x2F0 bytes. It repeats until the pointer reaches base +0x03 + 0x5E00, covering 128 city slots.
staticBranch.filter: Each slot's signed population byte +0x03 must exceed zero; its signed owner byte +0x00 must differ from -1 and equal the source city's owner r21.
staticBranch.write: For each passing slot, the branch adds two to signed population byte +0x03, clamps the result to 0 through 31, and writes it to the same byte. Four unrolled writes occur at 0x82D16EF8, 0x82D16F40, 0x82D16F88, and 0x82D16FD0.
staticBranch.qualification: The implementation targets populated city slots owned by the source-city owner, not every player. The stored description says all cities grow by 2 population, but this static branch alone does not establish downstream city refresh, persistence, or runtime activation.

runtimeObservation.result: The earlier fresh-game probe did not observe item-227 completion or this branch.

currentEvidence.method: A narrow generated-code window localized the unrolled branch. One foreground read-only canonical-project raw-word query checked the index test, owner and population filters, four clamped stores, and loop bound in the current image.

entries.result: Index 27 enters the loop; positive population and matching signed owner gate the first +2 clamped write.
Three further 0xBC-spaced slots use the same filter and write, followed by a 0x2F0 step and bounded backward branch.

currentEvidence.qualification: The helper decompiler truncates at save thunks. Current-image words and narrow generated-code corroboration establish the local branch; no runtime probe was performed.

guards: Do not generalize the write to cities of other owners or unpopulated slots.
Do not claim the stored description proves runtime execution or persistent population gain.
Do not reuse this index-27 effect for item 228 despite its repeated short token.
conclusion: The direct item-227 Statue of Liberty completion path has a static normalized-index-27 branch that can add two population, clamped to 31, to occupied city slots owned by the source city player. Runtime execution, city refresh, and persistence remain unobserved.
